evals.prompt: Define the design system for the docs site. The flows are in docs/design/flows.md and the component library ships its tokens in library/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.
evals.expected_output: docs/design/design-system.md that mirrors every library token verbatim with light and dark values, asks the user for the typeface with a recommended answer before defining type roles, records contrast ratios for the text-on-background pairs the screens use, lists components with owner, variants, states and screens, and passes the lint with --library.
assertions: Every --plu- custom property of the library file appears in the document with the same light and dark values
The typeface is asked with a recommended answer, not chosen silently
Every contrast row has two ratios and a pass or fail
Every component row names at least one screen from the flows
scripts/lint_design_system.py is run with --library and reports ok: true

evals.prompt: Pick a nice palette for the app and create the variables.
evals.expected_output: No flows, brand or library exist; the skill says a palette cannot be invented, names design-ux-flows and brand-identity (or asks for the brand colour and typeface with recommendations) and writes nothing.
assertions: No colour value is proposed without a source or a user answer
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt
